title: curie diff --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie diff`: every chart value the effective installation plan and the live release disagree about, plus the values the release carries that the plan does not declare. Read only. Declared credentials and provider addresses are resolved to construct the same plan used by apply, but no cluster state is mutated. Secret-bearing values are rendered as the literal string `<secret>` and never in the clear.

release_exists.description: False when helm has no record of the release, in which case every declared value is an `add`.

changes.description: How many entries would actually change the cluster: add, change, and reset. Deliberately excludes `unchanged` and `preserved`, so zero means applying the file is a no-op.

key.description: The dotted chart value path, in helm `--set` syntax including `[i]` array indexing.

kind.description: `preserved` means the release carries this value, the plan does not declare it, and apply re-supplies it anyway (Slack tokens, the GitHub App, generated store passwords). It is not a pending removal. `reset to chart default` is the genuine loss case: undeclared and not carried forward.

from.description: The live value, or null when the release does not have this key. `<secret>` when the key carries a credential.

to.description: The declared value, or null when the file does not declare this key. `<secret>` when the key carries a credential.
